metadata.question: Does Cambodia have more active fire detections in February 2018 compared to August 2017?

data.raw_code:

2. Masking strategy: Not applicable; we’re counting active fire detections (points), not imagery. Cloud masking is irrelevant.

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const getCambodia = async () => {
      try {
        const lsib = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
          .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Cambodia'));
        const n1 = await lsib.size().getInfo();
        if (n1 > 0) return lsib.geometry();
      } catch (e) {}
      const gaul = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0')
        .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Cambodia'));
      const n2 = await gaul.size().getInfo();
      if (n2 > 0) return gaul.geometry();
      console.log('Region lookup failed.');
      console.log('D');
      return null;
    };

    const region = await getCambodia();
    if (!region) return;

    const feb18Start = ee.Date('2018-02-01');
    const feb18End = ee.Date('2018-03-01');
    const aug17Start = ee.Date('2017-08-01');
    const aug17End = ee.Date('2017-09-01');

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    const datasetCandidates = ['MODIS/061/MCD14DL', 'MODIS/006/MCD14DL'];

    async function getCounts(datasetId) {
      try {
        const fc = ee.FeatureCollection(datasetId);
        const feb = fc.filterDate(feb18Start, feb18End).filterBounds(region);
        const aug = fc.filterDate(aug17Start, aug17End).filterBounds(region);
        const febCount = await feb.size().getInfo();
        const augCount = await aug.size().getInfo();
        return { datasetId, febCount, augCount };
      } catch (e) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    let counts = null;
    for (const ds of datasetCandidates) {
      counts = await getCounts(ds);
      if (counts) break;
    }
    if (!counts) {
      console.log('Dataset access error for active fire points.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }

    const { datasetId, febCount, augCount } = counts;

    // 3. Validation and Final Answer
    const invalid = (v) => v === null || v === undefined || Number.isNaN(v);
    if (invalid(febCount) || invalid(augCount)) {
      console.log(`Counts invalid. Feb: ${febCount}, Aug: ${augCount}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Concise evidence (<=20 lines)
    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetId}`);
    console.log(`Region: Cambodia`);
    console.log(`Feb 2018 Fire Detections: ${febCount}`);
    console.log(`Aug 2017 Fire Detections: ${augCount}`);
    console.log(`Difference (Feb - Aug): ${febCount - augCount}`);

    // Final tag
    if (febCount > augCount) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Unhandled error occurred.');
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
